_doc: Known differences from recorded vanilla, per case: the exact mismatch ids (docs/QUIRK_PARITY.md) and why. Listed mismatches report as known-divergence; any other mismatch fails, and so does a listed one that stopped occurring. Fix the implementation, never the recording or a tolerance.

tnt-duper-found-bud.reason: TNT duplication is not reproducible in Krasnokamen: pistons move blocks at once (no moving_piston block, no 2-tick travel), so the vanilla window in which a BUD TNT is pushed while its old cell is still updated does not exist. In 'armed' vanilla still holds the BUD TNT block in cells 0-2 while Krasnokamen has already primed it (26.3 replay .analysis/validation/20261127T103141-quirk-parity-zkit5o6g). Architectural (piston movement model), not a small fix.

tnt-bud-push-destroy-list.reason: The TNT outcome agrees (moved, not primed; entity counts equal), but in 'fired' vanilla leaves a non-waterlogged dead_tube_coral_fan in the destroy-list cells 1 and 5 and Krasnokamen a waterlogged one: flow and waterlogging order around the instant piston push (26.3 replay .analysis/validation/20261127T103141-quirk-parity-zkit5o6g; same piston movement model as tnt-duper-found-bud).
